cards.title: Built on Ontario's curriculum, and four more
cards.text: bina uses the Ontario Curriculum as its Canadian reference, alongside US Common Core, England's National Curriculum, Cambridge and Australia's. Each topic is taught at the earliest grade any of them teaches it, so fractions, grammar and phonics often come earlier than in Ontario schools.
